text:
Hannah Li: Heads-up: ACME Logistics usage dropped ~52% WoW, renewal in 18 days. They just opened a ticket about slow inference at peak. Flagging for a rescue mini-sprint.

Ravi Singh: On it. Do we have last-30d activity + top failing routes? @eng-bot can you post recent SLO breaches?

eng-bot: ALERT: model-serving latency spikes for account acme-logistics between 14:00-15:30 UTC on 2026-02-12. 95th p75 increased from 120ms -> 480ms.

Jorge M: Yikes — that'll hurt adoption. Proposing a "mini-sprint" salvage flow: 1) remediation call w/ eng+CSM, 2) temporary credits + trial extension, 3) 2-week ROI walkthrough, 4) friction-minimized downgrade-safeguard that preserves integrations.

Anika - CSM: Love it. I can own the customer call. Proposed agenda: 15m triage (logs+perf), 20m quick config fixes, 25m enablement (3 high-value use cases + metrics). Need an eng rep for triage.

Ravi Singh: @Jorge I can pair. Quick checklist I pulled together:
- prep: perf logs, traces, sample requests
- quick fixes: lower batch size to 8, enable prefix caching, pin kernel candidate
- offer: 2 months credits, 30-day trial extension
- follow-up: 1 checkpoint in 7 days
Owner: Hannah Li, Eng: Ravi Singh
Due: renewal_date - 3 days

Hannah Li: I'll draft the outreach + ROI slide. Draft ping: "We observed a latency spike affecting your peak window — we've scheduled a focused session to restore baseline and are offering 2 months of credits while we work through it."

Jorge M: Also include a safe downgrade route: keep their model alias intact, export KV cache, and a read-only fallback to a smaller model to avoid full outage. Add a "no data migration" guarantee to reduce friction.

Anika - CSM: Scheduling Tues 10am PT. Invite includes pre-call checklist and a short form for the customer to attach failing request IDs. :calendar:

Hannah Li: :thumbsup: Quick ask — Ravi, can you prepare a 5-slide ROI brief showing token cost before/after, expected latency delta, and customer-visible regressions?

Ravi Singh: Will do. ETA EOD today.

eng-bot: REMINDER: Incident playbook 'fast-sprint' recommended for latency regressions impacting top 10% of customers.

Hannah Li: Outreach + credits message drafted. Posting to #customer-success-drafts for one-line signoff before I send.

Anika - CSM: If they still choose to downgrade, let's make it frictionless: include a migration checklist in the ticket + 1 free enablement hour post-downgrade.

Jorge M: Agree. Also add an A/B rollback window (48-72h) so we can re-upgrade quickly if usage/metrics recover.

Hannah Li: Thanks team — clear owners: Ravi prepare slides; Ravi+Jorge identify perf toggles (examples below); Anika schedule call & send invite; Hannah send outreach + credits. I'll update thread after the call.

Ravi Singh: Example quick toggles I'll bring to the call:
```
# quick tweak
service.config.batch_size = 8
service.config.enable_prefix_cache = true
```
These are low-risk and often restore tail latency quickly.

Anika - CSM: Received. I'll include the downgrade-safeguard language in the invite and customer-facing doc.

Hannah Li: Closing the loop here — will post results after the mini-sprint. Thanks all."
